rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Everyone, it seems our read on this was right on the mark. The force that appeared at <book(25)>Shirahime<endbook()> has shown up again.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Right now, "<book(26)>Amaterasu<endbook()><thumbnail(210)>" is under their attack, and its main computer has gone out of control. In short, it is in chaos.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Also, a <color(5)>ship of unknown affiliation<ce()>, seemingly a separate force, has appeared and is fighting them.
rows.notes: "ship of unknown affiliation" matches the corpus's established "unit of unknown affiliation" form. Orchestrator: shortened to fit three lines. Orchestrator: shortened to fit three lines.

rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Given the situation, I doubt it is an ally... but we will stay wary of this force while we intercept the enemy.
<thumbdown()><topic()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Forces of <book(12)>Neo Zeon<endbook()> and the former <book(18)>Giganos<endbook()> have also been confirmed.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Why they are here is unclear, but we too will likely have to fight them. Enemies all around, but I am counting on you.
<topic()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Oh, right. This mission will also include the <book(26)>Amaterasu<endbook()> defense unit's leader, <color(4)>Ryoko Subaru<ce()><thumbnail(211)>.
rows.notes: Ryoko Subaru (given-family order) per character_names_021 en_full; -san honorific dropped per project convention.

rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>It is something of a nostalgic reunion... but the situation allows no delay. Please hurry your preparations.
